localeAndTextSize: German; actual system accessibility maximum per testCase
method: Viewed every SHA-unique original PNG with view_image(detail=original). Used manifest testCase for locale attribution; no montage, crop, AX dump or filename-only classification substituted for pixels.
scopeSummary: New Me history section/entry, existing full readonly expired card carried into its dedicated history page, original date/time, expiration explanation, repeat entry, repeat editor visible top and fixed publish button, cancel state, back-return history entry.
limitations: OS AssistiveTouch floating control is present in original device captures; it covers some right-side empty space, adjacent existing text or part of chevron space. The new history label and repeat action text remain readable.

Some captures are intermediate continuous scroll positions, with card content cut by the top/bottom viewport or behind the existing bottom bar. Later supplied original captures bring the relevant new entry and repeat action fully above the bottom bar.
The original repeat editor screenshot assesses only the visible top categories/title/close and fixed publish button, not all editor fields below the viewport.
Adjacent existing Me rows such as Mitgliedschaft wrap mid-word at actual maximum size. They were not changed by stage 226; no whole-app maximum-size approval is asserted.
Screenshot pixel review alone does not establish tap target dimensions or persistence/network behavior; those are covered separately by the phone flow tests.
